body: Universal LLM Deployment Engine with ML Compilation
plain_description: The big picture: MLC LLM lets you run large language models on nearly any device — laptop, phone, or web browser — without needing a cloud server. Here's why it matters: you get fast, private, on-device AI with OpenAI-compatible APIs. The bottom line: one engine to deploy LLMs everywhere.
technical_description: MLC LLM is a machine learning compiler and high-performance deployment engine for large language models. It uses MLCEngine, a unified inference runtime that compiles models via TVM and TensorIR for GPU backends including CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, Metal, OpenCL, and WebGPU. The engine exposes an OpenAI-compatible API through REST, Python, JavaScript, iOS, and Android bindings, enabling cross-platform deployment with a single optimized codebase.
title: MLC LLM
